description: Unit test class for the CommandSourceService in the Apache Fineract project, testing creation, retrieval, and error handling of command sources.

classes.name: CommandSourceServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CommandSourceService, testing core functionalities and error handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes Mockito annotations before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: testCreateFromWrapper
methods.description: Tests creation of a new CommandSource from a CommandWrapper, ensuring the idempotency key and status are correctly set.

methods.name: testCreateFromExisting
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an existing CommandSource by ID.

methods.name: testGenerateErrorException
methods.description: Verifies error handling and mapping when a CodeNotFoundException is thrown.
